name: Mixed-Grip Pull-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with one palm facing away from you and the other palm facing toward you.
Set your shoulder blades down, brace your core, and keep your legs straight or crossed calmly beneath you.
Pull your chest smoothly upward toward the bar by driving your elbows down until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly back to a full dead hang with straight arms.
tips: Switch which hand uses the overhand and underhand grip on alternate sets to keep your pulling balanced.
Keep your body centered beneath the bar instead of twisting toward the underhand side.
